tools.name: al.entity.get
tools.description: Resolve a company, grid or government by name, ticker or id and return its role, Four Forces, the chokepoints it holds, and every sourced link to its suppliers and customers.

tools.name: al.exposure.get
tools.description: Walk upstream from an entity through sourced dependency links and return every supplier reached, how many steps away it is, and the chokepoints inside that supply chain.

tools.name: al.path.find
tools.description: Find the shortest chain of sourced links showing how one entity ("to") depends on another ("from"), e.g. how Anthropic depends on ASML.

tools.name: al.chokepoints.get
tools.description: List AI-economy chokepoints with who holds them, sourced observations, and exmxc interpretation kept separate. Filter by force or status.

tools.name: al.changes.get
tools.description: Dated, sourced events that changed the AI Lattice in 2026.

tools.name: al.money.get
tools.description: For an entity: where its AI money comes from, where it goes, its spending commitments, and sourced money flows to and from named parties (equity, compute contracts, chip purchases, loans, bonds). tools.name: al.power.get
